profile.headline: Senior Golang Software Engineer, Contractor assigned at Google
profile.summary: Skilled and well-organized professional, with over 13 years in the Technology field, and experience in software development and engineering. Experience in design, development, testing, maintenance and documentation of enterprise applications in Java and Golang. Passion for software engineering, data visualization, learning, coding, documentation, and troubleshooting. Love to learn new technology and software and create innovative and efficient solutions

positions.title: Senior Golang Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on over 5 projects utilizing and implementing technologies such as AI, gRPC, Soy, SQL scripts, dashboards, Datasites, automation and deployment tools. 
Tech Stack: Go, GoogleSQL, SCSS, PLX, Soy, SCSS
•	Upgraded a Data Classification application from PaLM API to Gemini API using golang, improving performance and quality and accuracy of the models output. Created unit and integration tests.
•	Created a responsive and user accessible UI for AI powered application using Soy, HTML, SCSS.
•	Led Dashboard Metrics Development for all department applications and services. Creation, testing and deployment of dashboards and datasites.
•	Created SQL queries, SQL modules, user-defined functions (UDF), table-value functions (TVF) and unit and integration tests for queries, modules, UDFs and TVFs.
•	Initiated and completed several software research and discovery to investigate and gather information on potential software, tools and services to determine the project and technical feasibility and business goal.
•	Part-time Scrum master for daily standups. Scrum process improvements and documentation.
•	Designed a high-performance API using Golang and gRPC.
•	Used Golang to create backend servers.
•	Involved in requirement analysis, design, coding and unit testing.

positions.title: Data Analyst II
positions.description:
Project Description: Responsible for statistical modeling, and analysis of structured and unstructured datasets to develop metrics, reports, and visualizations of trends and patterns. Identify and capture data from internal and external sources. Ensure consistency throughout ongoing projects. Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. 
•	Created a Datasite comprising of several dashboards to monitor and report on a multi-million dollar global project.
•	Created complex workflows to manage and streamline various data sources and GoogleSQL scripts and tables.
•	 Perform quality assurance on data to determine potential data gaps.
•	Assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business. 
•	Conduct quantitative/ qualitative data analysis using tools and functions such as GoogleSQL, Dashboards, and Google spreadsheets.
•	Collaborate with individuals throughout the organization to understand data visualizations needs for customer feedback
•	Constructs forecasts, recommendations and strategic/tactical plans based on business data and market knowledge
•	Work with client stakeholders to improve, automate and align data with current client processes
•	Creates specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and required or available data elements
•	Produces datasets and reports for analysis using system reporting tools
•	Provide consultation to users and lead cross-functional teams to address business issues
•	Actively develops new tools and system enhancements, troubleshoots and solves data issues

positions.title: Technical Program Management Specialist - Signature Consultants Contractor at Google
positions.description:
Project Description: Go Automation Software to minimize time spent on user tickets. This software operates based on user input submitted through tickets. Custom logic and responses were created to handle 90% of scenarios experienced in this environment, therefore saving employees hours in examining and responding to user tickets and requests and ultimately saving money. 
●    Designed, developed and implemented software automation program in GoLang to minimize time spent evaluating incoming tickets. 
●	Developed highly scalable microservices in GoLang to process data and update Angular frontend.
●	Designed and implemented unit tests in GoLang.
●	Utilized custom API’s to connect and retrieve information from in-house database systems.
●	Experience in GoLang concepts like Slices, Maps, Structs, Interfaces, Go routines and Channels and extensive working knowledge with Microservices,
●	Designed and coded scheduled jobs to run automation software.
●	Maintained and upgraded automation software.
Technologies used: GO, Piper, Cider, Microservices, Channels, Linux, Go Routines

Daily duties:
●	Manage technical projects from conception to completion, as well as providing necessary updates and feedback in agile environment.
●	Managed fleet wide inventory by analyzing usage metrics to create a 10% budget savings in Q1.
●	Provided technical training sessions for Technical Program Managers. 
●	Managed the migration of services within or outside data centers globally.
●	Managed Monarch inventory, by monitoring and allocating resources to ensure 100% availability to users. 
●	Provided resource forecasting for Monarch zones for upcoming quarters. 
●	Writing and executing complex commands in Linux.
●	Created and managed resource inventory and forecasting dashboards, powered by complex SQL/GoogleSQL scripts, to improve availability and efficiency of resources. 
●	Utilize Issue Tracking to address user tickets and ChangeList software to execute multiple commands.

positions.title: Golang / Flutter Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
●	Implemented Firebase Cloud Messaging in the application which is used to trigger app functions when a remote configuration is changed. 
●	Management and updating microservices for mobile application.
●	Provided maintenance on existing mobile features within the application.
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Application Development · Go (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Flutter · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: IT Support Technician -> DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
●	Responsible for resolving python application bugs assigned through Jira, using Visual Studio code, requesting code reviews and deploying the application.
●	Used Jenkins to help build and deploy Emburse in-house web applications.
●	Created various dashboards to monitor team performance and efficiency, providing better insight and aiding management decisions. 
●	Project manager, created and implemented Error budget, and monitoring dashboard to track SLO's, to ensure the delivery as promised. 
●	Project manager, engineer and creator of company’s IT Hub, housing IT processes, automated processes through this hub, increasing productivity, efficiency and reliability with the services provided. 
●	Image, configure and setup new and existing laptops: Dell, MacBook.  
●	Software troubleshooting: Gmail, MS office, Slack, Quickbooks etc. 
●	Process Documentation and testing 
●	Revising and creating new process documentation according to the department needs and processes. Created custom templates. 
●	Resolving tickets and incidents with Jira. 
●	Upgrading System and Software to reflect modern IT standards, Network, User Management. 
●	Administering: G-Suite, Telzio, Slack, and Zoom.

positions.title: Support Engineer II
positions.description:
●	Image, configure and setup new and existing laptops: Dell, HP, and MacBook. Configure BYOD devices. 
●	Laptop hardware repairs and replacement. Software troubleshooting: WebEx, MS office, Slack, etc. 
●	Process Documentation and testing-Revising and creating new process documentation according to the department needs and processes. Created custom templates. 
●	Resolving tickets and incidents through ServiceNow and increasing user satisfaction. 
●	Troubleshooting MacBook Airs and MacBook Pros

positions.title: Go Full Stack Software Developer with Java
positions.description:
●	Responsible for front-end and back-end web development.
●	Responsible for solving high-level and high-priority bugs within the application, using Angular 9, Go/Golang, Typescript, HTML5, JavaScript, SQL server and CSS3.
●	Developed back-end logic in Go.
●	Lead developer for angular – responsible for angular configuration, routing and component set up.
